fireball: A glowing orb with a white core, orange middle and red-orange edge flies straight ahead trailing fire particles, then bursts in an orange shockwave with sparks.
gale_blast: A thin cyan crescent arc flies fast along the lane, shedding wind particles and leaving a gust trail behind it.
chain_lightning: Pale-yellow zig-zag bolts with a gold glow flash briefly from target to target (or straight ahead), with yellow hit sparks.
stone_spikes: Four dark-brown triangular rock spikes shoot up from the ground one after another, each taller than the last, over a ground crack.
frost_nova: A cyan ring expands quickly around the caster's feet and leaves an icy ground patch; frozen enemies get a translucent cyan ice block.
summon_lesser_beast: The untinted spirit-wolf sprite (about 58px) appears in a lilac shockwave with particles and runs around with a small lilac health bar.
construct_bulwark: A row of blue-grey stone blocks with lit top faces and masonry lines rises along the swiped line, with construct particles around it.
void_bolt: A smaller, faster orb with a pale-pink core, magenta middle and deep-purple edge, trailing void particles and bursting in a magenta shockwave.
halo_pulse: A warm golden-white elliptical ring spreads across the ground with a faint gold fill and ten short light rays rising from it, then fades.
shadow_step: No dedicated visual: the caster teleports instantly, with small dark-purple shockwave rings where they leave and where they appear.
shadow_doppelganger: A copy of the caster's own sprite, tinted dark violet and slightly see-through, rises behind them giving off purple void motes.
revenant_call: A pale green-tinted body of a fallen fighter rises out of the ground through a green seal ellipse, kicking up dust, and later bursts in a green shockwave.
annihilation_beam: A long charge into a glowing magenta orb, then a thick pulsing magenta-pink beam with a white core and a flare at the hand, plus a camera shake.
void_implosion: A pulsing dark sphere with a black center fading to violet, with dashed rotating violet arcs and orbiting lilac dots, then a solid violet flash that shrinks away.
inferno_rampage: A big pulsing fireball head races along the ground trailing alternating orange and yellow fire blobs, orbiting yellow sparks and scorch marks.
summon_storm_wolf: The storm-wolf sprite (about 58px) appears in a yellow shockwave with lightning particles and has a small yellow health bar.
summon_void_spider: The void-spider sprite appears in a magenta shockwave with void particles; its bites leave small magenta shockwaves.
summon_rune_golem: The siege-golem sprite, untinted and about 84px tall, appears in a pale-grey shockwave and lumbers forward with a grey health bar.
firestorm: A swirling tornado of seven stacked ellipse rings that alternate orange and yellow and widen toward the top, drifting across the lane with fire and wind particles.
meteor_cataclysm: A glowing red-orange ball with a yellow glow streaks down at an angle, hits in a big red shockwave with sparks, and leaves a translucent red molten crater.
tempest_blitz: The caster blinks forward along a glowing cyan straight line, with cyan shockwave rings at the start and end points.
magma_fissure: A flat glowing red-orange ellipse of molten ground sits on the lane with fire particles bubbling up from it.
sandstorm_bastion: A dashed golden-yellow circle with a pale-cyan glow surrounds the caster, with sand and wind particles swirling inside.
blizzard_surge: A pale icy-blue ring outline drifts slowly forward, shedding water and ice particles and leaving ice patches on the ground.
aura_shock: A violet shockwave ring bursts out from the caster with lightning particles and electrified ground; lilac sparks fly off hit enemies.
arcane_aegis: A glowing violet translucent oval bubble surrounds the caster (or a smaller pulsing violet circle forms around an ally), with a violet shockwave on cast.
stone_wall: A row of dark-brown stone blocks with lighter top faces and masonry lines rises up, cracks as it is damaged, and collapses into dust and rubble.
inferno_beam: After a short charge orb, a layered orange beam with a white-hot core shoots out, with flickering flame blobs licking along its top.
glacial_ray: After a short charge orb, a layered pale-cyan beam with a white core shoots out, with small crystal shard spikes along its upper edge.
thunder_lance: After a short charge orb, three jittering yellow and white lightning strands crackle over a faint gold glow along a long line.
null_ray: After a short charge orb, a magenta-edged beam with a nearly black center and a thin pale core shoots out, with pink motes drifting back toward the caster.
mirror_ward: A pulsing pale-cyan ellipse ring surrounds the caster, with captured shots orbiting it as colored dots until they fire back as glowing bolts.
gravity_lift: Thin lilac curved threads run from the caster's hand to each enemy hovering in the air, with a lilac ring under each one, then they are slammed down.
seismic_slam: A line of brown triangular ground spikes and cracks travels forward with earth particles, leaving short-lived brown rock pillars behind.
titan_stomp: The caster leaps and crashes down; a wide brownish ellipse shockwave spreads and fades on landing, leaving a crater and earth particles.
dragon_breath: A widening cone of chunky dark-outlined flame blobs streams forward, going from yellow to orange to red and ending as grey smoke.
burrow_strike: A wobbling brown dirt mound with pebbles marks the buried caster, then six brown rock shards burst outward in an arc when they come up.
shadow_stomper: After a hop and a stomp, a wavy dark-violet ribbon of shadow races over the ground to the target, forming a dark pool with clutching shadow fingers under it.
radiant_lance: After a short charge orb, a bright golden beam with a pulsing glow and a white core shoots out, with tiny glinting motes drifting along it.
solar_orb: A golden light pillar rises; a pixel-art sun with rotating rays appears in the sky's top right, and the field gets a warm golden tint.
lunar_orb: A light pillar rises; a pale-blue cratered pixel moon appears in the sky, the field darkens to deep blue and shadows grow longer.
eclipse: A light pillar rises; a black disc covering a glowing yellow corona with flickering rays appears in the sky, and the field turns very dark.
thunderhead: A light pillar rises; dark grey pixel storm clouds with flickering lightning appear in the sky, yellow rings mark strikes and lightning sprites hit with screen flashes.
blood_moon: A light pillar rises; a dark-red cratered pixel moon with a red glow appears in the sky, the field takes a crimson tint and shadows turn red.
starfall: A light pillar rises; twinkling pixel stars fill the sky, and shooting stars streak down onto pale ground rings, flashing white on impact.
aurora_veil: A light pillar rises; wavy green, blue and violet aurora bands ripple across the sky, and the field gets a teal tint.
mirror_gate: Two standing ice mirrors appear, each with a teal frame, a glassy gradient face, moving shine streaks, ice crystals on top and a frosty ground ring.
soul_seekers: Three small glowing pink-violet orbs with white cores fan out a moment apart and curve toward enemies, trailing void particles.
eidolon_mantle: A huge see-through violet skeletal guardian forms behind the caster: void flames, a horned skull helm, purple armor and a crystal greatsword, plus a violet glow around them.
ninefold_beast_form: Nine flame tails in orange, amber and yellow fan out behind the caster, with a fiery fox-spirit head above them and an orange glow around the body.
dragon_invocation: A large fire-dragon sprite (about 170px) appears above the field, breathes a glowing yellow-orange flame line at the ground, then fades out with a big orange shockwave.
summon_rune_snake: The world-rune-serpent sprite (about 90px) appears in a violet shockwave with void particles; its attacks give off violet shockwaves.
summon_spirit_wolf: The spirit-wolf sprite (about 58px) appears in a light-blue shockwave with water particles and has a light-blue health bar.
summon_siege_golem: The siege-golem sprite (about 84px) appears in a brown shockwave with earth particles and has a brown health bar.
apocalyptic_heavensurge: No unique visual: it plays the Firestorm vortex, a falling Meteor with its crater and the Blizzard Surge ring together, with a heavy camera shake.
